description: Image Description: The image shows a large-scale mural painted on the side of a black brick building. The central feature of the artwork is a stylized, oversized white toaster with two slots on top, depicted in a minimalist and geometric design. The toaster is surrounded by an intricate pattern composed of repeating geometric shapes, including triangles, diamonds, and squares, arranged in a mosaic-like fashion.
